mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_knowledge_version ( version_id, product_id, version_number, product_name, category, description, key_features, target_industries, risk_level, required_materials, pricing_basis, previous_version_id, change_summary, changed_by, changed_at ) VALUES ( #{versionId}, #{productId}, #{versionNumber}, #{productName}, #{category}, #{description}, #{keyFeatures, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{targetIndustries, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{riskLevel}, #{requiredMaterials, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{pricingBasis}, #{previousVersionId}, #{changeSummary}, #{changedBy}, #{changedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT version_id, product_id, version_number, product_name, category, description, key_features, target_industries, risk_level, required_materials, pricing_basis, previous_version_id, change_summary, changed_by, changed_at FROM product_knowledge_version WHERE version_id = #{versionId}

SELECT version_id, product_id, version_number, product_name, category, description, key_features, target_industries, risk_level, required_materials, pricing_basis, previous_version_id, change_summary, changed_by, changed_at FROM product_knowledge_version WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY version_number DESC

SELECT version_id, product_id, version_number, product_name, category, description, key_features, target_industries, risk_level, required_materials, pricing_basis, previous_version_id, change_summary, changed_by, changed_at FROM product_knowledge_version WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY version_number DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT version_id, product_id, version_number, product_name, category, description, key_features, target_industries, risk_level, required_materials, pricing_basis, previous_version_id, change_summary, changed_by, changed_at FROM product_knowledge_version WHERE category = #{category} ORDER BY product_name, version_number DESC

SELECT version_id, product_id, version_number, product_name, category, description, key_features, target_industries, risk_level, required_materials, pricing_basis, previous_version_id, change_summary, changed_by, changed_at FROM product_knowledge_version ORDER BY changed_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
